title: feat(nm2frm1sfz): directed 1-step cyclic-frame transport along -e3 at t+1 on three-axis far-face opposite seed: reverse fails, face fails
science: One directed -e_3 hop from each of the four seeds of the three-axis far-face opposite host: two edges HOLD with det P equal to the product of the two Orient signs and two fail because the origin's split fails once the far-face third pair locks +e_3, so reverse and face both fail. The same origin frame HOLDs on the four-site two-axis seed, so the failure is a property of the six-site host.
